title: The Saddle Crossings — no straight walk in negative curvature
license_note: Original Mag module. Cites RIB_CATHEDRAL_WORLD_V1 invariants; legislates nothing new (monkey-patch ruling).

descent_order_ford.name: The Descent-Order Ford
descent_order_ford.desc: A saddle crossing between water-first descent and hub-first radiant order. The ground has negative curvature: geodesics diverge, no straight walk exists. Both normals are drawn on the far bank.
hooks: SADDLE LAW: movement in straight lines is refused; the detour IS the riddle (negative curvature = no unique geodesic).
Cited invariant: RIB descent-order (CONTESTED). Tiebreak gated on operator GO — third-model geodesic.
Eigen-vote plaque: the estate's own metric voted; read CATHEDRAL_CURVATURE_SCAN JSON — a vote, not a verdict.

gate_style_sluice.name: The Gate-Style Sluice
gate_style_sluice.desc: Valve heights (Grok normal) against the computed-water flag (DeepSeek normal). Two gates, one passage; the wrong gate pours nothing that counts.
hooks: Referee hook: third-model geodesic — ARMED, fires only on operator GO (RIB filing law: tiebreak if the operator orders it).

hill_causeway.name: The Hill Causeway
hill_causeway.desc: Where both normals agree, the ground is elliptic and walking straight is legal — settled invariants carry the player. Regions: none yet
hooks: HILL LAW: geodesics are unique; straight walks allowed.
Cited invariants: the AGREE list of RIB_CATHEDRAL_WORLD_V1.

meta_discovery_protocol: Every crossing played files one row: what the model-family did in negative curvature that it refuses on the hill.
Loop count per run = first Betti-number proxy of the doctrine graph; loops discovered in-play are meta-findings, filed to watch/inbox per session-close law.
